climate_pressure: Coastal erosion, flooding and other climate-related environmental pressures.
documented_impact: Community research describes threatened land/livelihoods and movement away from exposed settlements.
fcv_mediator: Limited relocation land, unequal access, customary tenure and community identity shape mobility options.
possible_consequence: Relocation can generate land disputes or social tensions when access and participation are not resolved.
alternative_explanations: Education, employment and family connections also drive mobility.
Land exclusion, external project design and existing governance disputes can cause tension independently of climate.
uncertainty: Conditional synthesis of selected-site research and contextual peacebuilding analysis, not a nationwide causal estimate. Source-specific examples do not establish that each mechanism occurs in every named site.
resilience_factors: Kinship networks, local leadership and traditional knowledge.
Inclusive customary-land decisions and participation by women, young people and persons with disabilities.
compact_statement: Climate pressures can interact with relocation land constraints and exclusion to create tensions; kinship networks and inclusive local decisions can support adaptation.
